[{"step":1,"file":"c/tests/fuzz/fuzz-message-decode.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":24,"var":"Data/Size","code":"pn_message_decode(msg, (const char *)Data, Size)","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are passed directly into the AMQP message decoder."},{"step":2,"file":"c/src/core/message.c","function":"pn_message_decode","line":766,"var":"msg_bytes","code":"size_t section_size = pn_amqp_decode_DQLq(msg_bytes, &scanned, &desc);","note":"The decoder scans the next section header and descriptor from the input buffer, then advances by the reported section size."},{"step":3,"file":"c/src/core/message.c","function":"pn_message_decode","line":775,"var":"msg->durable/priority/ttl/first_acquirer/delivery_count","code":"pn_amqp_decode_DqEoQBIoIe(msg_bytes, ...)","note":"When the descriptor is HEADER, the header fields are decoded from the same attacker-controlled section payload."},{"step":4,"file":"c/src/core/consumers.h","function":"consume_list","line":555,"var":"consumer->position / s","code":"case PNE_LIST32: { uint32_t s; ... *subconsumer = ...; consumer->position += s; return pni_consumer_readf32(subconsumer, count); }","note":"A list32 length is trusted to create a subconsumer and advance the parent position before the element count is read from the subconsumer."},{"step":5,"file":"c/src/core/consumers.h","function":"pni_consumer_readf32","line":120,"var":"consumer->output_start[consumer->position+3]","code":"uint32_t d = consumer->output_start[consumer->position+3];","note":"The count read from the subconsumer requires four bytes; if the list payload is shorter than claimed, this indexed read goes past the end of the buffer."},{"step":6,"file":"c/src/core/message.c","function":"pn_message_decode","line":775,"var":"return value","code":"pn_amqp_decode_DqEoQBIoIe(msg_bytes, ...)","note":"The malformed header decode propagates the out-of-bounds read into the message decoder crash path."}]
JSON
